about.text: The second game of the FINAL FANTASY VII remake trilogy.

Experience the award-winning RPG with support for up to 4K resolution and 120 FPS, enhanced lighting and textures, variable refresh rate (VRR), NVIDIA DLSS, and more. The game also supports play using the DualSense® controller.
After escaping Midgar, the City of Mako, Cloud and his comrades shatter the barriers of fate and embark on a new journey into the wide world beyond.
A brand-new adventure awaits as a vast, multifaceted world unfolds before you. Gallop across grassy plains on the back of a chocobo as you explore the world before you.
■ Story

The lifestream represents the very cycle of life and death, where all life emerges from the planet and returns to its embrace. However, the Shinra Electric Power Company ruthlessly drains the planet of its very essence, the lifestream, and processes it for industry as "mako."

After overcoming countless fierce battles in the mako-powered metropolis of Midgar, ex-SOLDIER Cloud Strife and his companions step out into the wider world. Riding across grassy plains atop chocobos, they embark on an uncertain path, beginning their fated journey across the planet.

At the same time, SOLDIER First Class Zack Fair walks through the wastelands outside of Midgar. Wounded and weary, he drags his battered body forward while supporting his dear friend Cloud, who is delirious from mako poisoning. Beyond the veil of death, an ominous rift tears the heavens above.
Meanwhile, the Wutai interim government leads the Shinra Resistance Committee in a declaration of war.
In a grim procession, mysterious black-robed figures carry the remains of Jenova, the alien entity infamously known as the cataclysm from the stars and the catalyst of our plight.
Sensing the threat to the Planet itself, the fearsome guardians known as Weapons, awaken and rise from the lifestream.
Through the machinations of Cloud’s sworn enemy Sephiroth, the strands of destiny intertwine and are reborn again.
The FINAL FANTASY VII remake trilogy

The FINAL FANTASY VII remake project uses the latest technology to bring FINAL FANTASY VII - the legendary RPG that enchanted the world - to a new generation. Fans can now experience the beloved story reimagined.

The first game in the trilogy, FINAL FANTASY VII REMAKE, was released in 2020, achieving critical acclaim across the globe and shipping over seven million units worldwide. Now, the second game, FINAL FANTASY VII REBIRTH, continues the story at the heart of the trilogy.

about.text: When the old can no longer protect the land, the small must learn to carry the tune.

For as long as anyone can remember, a kind witch has cared for the forest and the creatures who call it home. But now, the world is beginning to fall out of harmony—and the witch who has always protected it is growing ill.

Her smallest familiars must venture beyond the shelter of home and learn to carry the responsibility that once belonged to her. Though she cannot join them, her magic is never far away—a gentle hand, ready to lift them back to safety.
Playing as a brave little mouse, you’ll journey through a vast world shaped by the beauty and wonder of Swedish nature, helping those you meet and restoring harmony one act of kindness at a time.

Hela: of Mice & Magic is a heartfelt 3D open-world adventure about care, courage, and discovering how much even the smallest among us can do. Explore alone or share the journey with friends in local split-screen and online co-op.
Carry Her Kindness Into the Wild
The witch has spent her life caring for the world around her. Now, it is your turn to care for her and to continue the work she can no longer carry alone.

Gather ingredients, brew magical potions, solve environmental puzzles, and lend a helping paw to animals and communities throughout the land. Each small act brings you closer to restoring its harmony and helping the witch who has long cared for you and all the forest’s inhabitants.
See the World Through Tiny Eyes
Travel through a lovingly crafted playground inspired by the landscapes of Northern Sweden, from rugged mountain trails and magical forests to tranquil lakes and misty wetlands.

To a mouse, even familiar places become enormous. Everyday objects transform into obstacles, opportunities, and unexpected playgrounds, while hidden paths and story fragments reward those who stop, listen, and look a little closer.
Glide through the air, climb to new heights, experiment with the world around you, and find your own way through an adventure filled with quiet wonder.
Share the Journey
Some adventures are meant to be shared. Experience the full adventure solo, with a friend in local split-screen, or in online co-op for up to four players.

Work together to explore the landscape, overcome challenges, and discover playful solutions. When you play solo, the Shade System lets you create magical copies of yourself to assist with puzzles and interact with the world, ensuring that every part of the journey remains open to you.
Meet Froggy
Your magical Froggy backpack is more than a useful tool, it is your constant companion on the road ahead.

Use Froggy to leap, swing, glide, gather resources, interact with the environment, and solve puzzles. As your journey continues, you’ll discover new ways for Froggy to help you reach hidden places and navigate a world built for curiosity.
Game Features:
Explore & Discover: Traverse an expansive, lovingly crafted region inspired by Northern Sweden, full of magical forests, tranquil lakes, and misty wetlands.

Play Your Way: Experience the journey solo, with a friend in local split-screen co-op, or in online co-op for up to four players. However you choose to play, explore freely and progress at your own pace.
Creative Puzzle Solving: Use creative thinking, cooperation, and the special properties of your remedies to solve playful challenges woven seamlessly into the world.

Melvor Idle 2 expands upon the beloved foundations of its predecessor and the wider world, to bring a deeper, richer, and more refined idle gaming experience. This single-player adventure lets you explore an ever-growing world of skills, combat, and strategy at your own pace.

Whether you're a veteran of idle games, a fan of the original Melvor or a maxxed out RuneScape completionist, Melvor Idle 2 offers a fresh adventure that balances depth with accessibility. It's the ultimate idle RPG for both busy adventurers and those ready to immerse themselves in a constantly evolving world

Master Melvor’s many unique skills with just a click or a tap. Melvor Idle 2 is a feature-rich, idle/incremental game combining a distinctly RuneScape feel with a fresh gameplay experience. Maxing your skills has never been more zen! If you are looking for a deep but accessible adventure that easily fits around a busy lifestyle, then Melvor Idle 2 is an idle experience unlike any other.

Every skill in this game serves a purpose, interacting with the others in interesting ways. This means all the hard work you put into one skill will in turn benefit others. What strategy will you conjure to achieve maximum skillage?

It doesn’t just end with Woodcutting, Smithing, Cooking and Farming either – take your finely honed tapping abilities into battle and face off against monsters using your Melee, Ranged and Magic skills. Conquering brutal dungeons and toppling boisterous bosses has never been quite like this before…

about.text: You don't remember who you are. Act like her. Talk like her.

Am I Nima is a psychological-horror game where you play as Nima, a girl who has lost all her memories and is being trapped in the basement by her mother. To escape, all you have to do is pass your mom’s tests and convince her that you really are her daughter.

As you explore, you uncover words tied to the objects around you: a worn-out plushie, a locked drawer, an old note scribbled in hurried handwriting. These words represent Nima's thoughts and emotions, giving you a peek into how Nima thinks and feels.
However, to really find the truth, you must actively combine words in Nima's mind, experimenting with different pairings to unlock deeper meanings and access buried memories.

When it comes to the tests, you’ll use your new found words to direct the conversation. Choose your words carefully, as they will change how Nima responds to her mom. Will you tell her what she wants to hear? Or will you probe her for the truth?
The more you uncover, the more questions arise: Why has your mother locked you in the basement? What do these tests mean? And are you really Nima?

Stunning Visuals

Enhanced levels of fidelity and performance with new graphics modes including ray tracing features such as ambient occlusion and global illumination, ray traced shadows and reflections, support for AMD FSR and NVIDIA DLSS, and more.*
Faster Loading
Quicker access to the action as the world of Los Santos and Blaine County load in faster than ever before by using SSD and DirectStorage on supported devices.

Grand Theft Auto Online

New Career Builder

New Menu Design
Immediately access everything GTA Online has to offer right from the main menu, including the latest and most popular updates.
Access to All Current and Previous Updates

about.text: MONOMOON is a non-linear game focused on exploration and discovery.
With no proper instructions, you must deduce and achieve your goals as you solve puzzles, find mysterious items, and uncover secrets hiding right under your nose.
Features
Explore a small open world "Metroidbrainia" that you can "complete" in about 10 hours, or dig deeper to find all that's hidden within.
Layers of secrets, ranging from simple puzzles to cryptic mysteries and hidden game mechanics. The game doesn't end after the credits roll...
A mix of platformer and point and click control schemes, utilizing both the keyboard and mouse. (Controllers are also supported but not recommended for the optimal experience)
Player-driven exploration and progression: explore and discover things at your own pace.

All puzzles and secrets can be solved by playing the game solo, and all clues exist within the game itself. However, we encourage discussing your playthrough with a friend to share knowledge and hints with one another.

Discover an enhanced Crimson Desert, featuring new cutscenes and story moments, plus expanded voice-over and language support. ​Begin the adventure loved by millions, refined since launch with a wealth of updates, including new content, mounts, pets, customization options, various quality-of-life improvements, and more. ​

On the continent of Pywel, the rival factions of Pailune maintained a tense balance. At Kliff's side stood his steadfast Greymane comrades, but a devastating ambush in the deep of night by their sworn enemies the Black Bears leaves members of the Greymanes dead or scattered across the continent.
Kliff—having lost his family in all but name—is determined to reunite with the survivors and rebuild the faction.

But on a journey where alliances are forged, dangers abound, and mysterious factions are uncovered, Kliff will meet those who seek to upend the very order of the continent and face a mission unlike any he has ever known.
Welcome to Pywel.

Here you'll find stretches of natural beauty and wilderness—from green plains and woods to arid deserts and rugged mountains—alongside bustling cities and quiet hamlets inhabited by residents from all walks of life. Between destinations, you will come across landmarks, ancient ruins, hidden treasures, and other points of interest that will draw your curisoity to wander. Your journey will also inevitably take you skyward to the mysterious realm known as the Abyss, where a mystical imbalance endangering the world must be restored.
The world is yours to explore as you will and there are many paths for you to uncover.

Experience the continent's stories and tales through quests, encounters, challenges, and battles. Roam the lands on various mounts from horses to even a dragon and mechs, and scale cliffsides and walls which you can leap from to glide.

The story of Crimson Desert centers on Kliff. But as his tale unfolds, 2 new playable characters—Oongka and Damiane—will come to join your journey. As these characters become available, you will be able to freely explore Pywel and undertake many quests outside the main story with them. Each character has their own combat style, as well as unique skills and weapons, allowing you to experience the world and its battles in different ways.
On the unforgiving battlefields of Crimson Desert, there is no single path to victory.​

Grow your arsenal of skills, weapons, and equipment—and decide how you want to use them. Powerful weapon skills can be paired with hard-hitting bare-hand hits and kicks, as well as a wide range of grapples to create seamless chains of attacks. Acquire weapons like swords, spears, greatswords, axes, dual wields, various ranged weapons, and more, and unleash powerful abilities and elemental enhancements through lethal combinations. Stay mobile and relentless with slides, dodges, counters, and swings that flow directly into your next attack. With every strike and move, forge your own way in a world where a split second can decide your fate in fast-paced, visceral battles.

From ruthless warriors to fearsome beasts, there are those in Pywel who will seek your downfall. Encounter a diverse array of challenging enemies and bosses in brutal one-on-one duels, large-scale battle clashes, and quick skirmishes, and prevail against the threats that stand in your way.
Pywel isn't just a continent of battles and exploration. It's a world where many of the smaller moments also shape your journey and make up your day-to-day life.

about.text: Cozy Game Restoration is about the quiet satisfaction of restoring something that matters. You’ll unwrap carefully sealed packages to discover old, battered video game cartridges. They'll be covered in stickers, markers, dust, and all the accumulation of time. Each one is different, flawed in its own way, and waiting to be brought back to life.
RESTORE FORGOTTEN RETRO GAMES

Every cartridge is procedurally dirtied. Some have clean labels but cracked shells. Others are scuffed, drawn on, or covered in adhesive residue. Grime is layered. Dust, ink, discoloration, stickers, and scratches each require a different tool to remove. Surfaces stretch, smear, and lift as you work. It’s slow, tactile, and satisfying.
LOOT BOXES BUT IN A GOOD WAY

Game cartridges will arrive inside mystery parcels sealed with tape. You’ll peel them open by hand, lifting the flaps, and wrestling with sticky tape to see what’s inside. Each game has randomized conditions and visuals, with 108 distinct titles inspired by classics from the 1980s to early 2000s.

Some are common finds, but others can be much rarer. You’ll encounter regional variants of carts, sticker artwork, and even shells made of gold (or better). Every game you restore will bring you closer to completing your collection, and there’s always a chance something unexpected will show up.
COMPLETE YOUR COLLECTION

As you restore games, you’ll complete collection-based quests. This might be simple stuff like “collect three puzzle games”, or “two rare platformers”, but you’ll also see more unique things which work with the game’s in-game calendar like “Have 4 sci-fi games on your game shelf on November 7”.
Each finished quest will reward you with a gift. Inside will be a decoration or cosmetic for your collection room that you can use to make it a little more personal.
BUILT FOR THE FEELING

There’s no timer and no fail state in this game, but that doesn’t mean it's a shallow experience. There’s a deep set of interwoven systems which keeps gameplay varied and interesting, all whilst respecting the quiet chill vibes of a cleaning game.
If you’ve ever carefully peeled a sticker, dug through 2nd hand store games for a rare gem, or reminisced about your old collection, this is for you.
The game runs great on desktop, but it is being built from the ground up for Steam Deck. I’m planning on making this performant on a pretty wide range of systems.

about.text: DREADMOOR is an atmospheric first-person fishing adventure game set in a flooded world. Skill-based fishing, survival crafting, real-time combat, and exploration through rotting wetlands define your journey across land claimed by sea and decay.

Take the helm of a fishing trawler and explore a world flooded by a catastrophic human mistake. Coastal regions have sunk beneath the water, and much of the remaining land has been submerged underwater. Travel between scattered settlements, catch fish to trade, upgrade your vessel, and craft essential equipment. Face mutated creatures across sea and land and move carefully through a divided world where resources are scarce, and trust is fragile.

Dozens of dangerous and rare species await beneath the surface. Scour the waters for the best fishing spots, experiment with different baits, and compete with the unpredictable forces of nature as you cast your line into the murky waters. Sort your catch and keep an eye on the hold. Sea creatures do not hesitate to devour each other. The more dangerous the prey, the higher the price offered by the mysterious traders of the Submerged Lands.

Seek out valuable resources along the way. In the Submerged Lands, scrap metal and forgotten blueprints are often worth their weight in gold. Explore abandoned buildings, caves, and shipwrecks in search of rare and useful finds.

Resources gathered across the Submerged Lands can be crafted into specialized bait, reinforced harpoons, rare medicines, and survival tools suited to the harsh realities of this world. Discover new recipes, refine your equipment, and adapt to the challenges that lie ahead.

Bring your trawler into dry dock and prepare it for the dangers ahead. Craft and install new components, shaping your vessel piece by piece. Upgrade your engine and propeller for greater speed and manoeuvrability, reinforce the hull, and keep spare fuel close at hand with a canister rack. Cut through the darkness with a spotlight, or engage the afterburner for a burst of speed when danger closes in. These and other upgrades are vital not only to explore the Submerged Lands, but also to make sure you can get back safely!

The waters and shores of The Submerged Land are inhabited by creatures twisted by catastrophe. Be prepared for real-time confrontations on sea and land – danger can emerge at any moment, turning routine expeditions into desperate fights for survival.

about.text: The last Sprýg Gnomes in Midgård are driven from their home by Oden and his corruption, leaving them one place left to go: Trollheim, a magical realm of mythical beings where trolls, faeries and sirens are real. Set out into the unknown to reunite with your lost kin, and behold the untold tales of the Väsen who dwell in the Dark Forest alongside you.

TROLLHEIM: GNOMES is a PvE survival adventure where you must reunite your gnome companions to survive and thrive together in the Dark Forest. Explore an ancient Nordic wilderness, uncover its mysteries, encounter the Väsen - the mythical beings of Nordic folk belief, and make the forest your home. Play solo or with up to 7 friends in a procedurally grown forest sandbox.
The Dark Forest found you.
Into the Dark Forest

Step into an ancient forest through the eyes of a tiny gnome. Every tall pine, mossy hill and damp rock is a climb, and every climb is a challenge of its own. Stumble across scattered gnome dwellings, delve into mossy caverns and explore carefully curated biomes teeming with life.

The pressure to survive drives you forward, opening up new possibilities and discoveries as the Dark Forest reveals itself as a living world of mystery, wonder and danger. Cold, hunger and hidden threats push you to adapt. Gather blueberries and twigs, craft everything from arrows to musical instruments. This is a wilderness not just meant to be explored, but a place to understand and ultimately call home.
Live Among the Väsen

The Väsen: Trolls, faeries, sirens and other mythical beings also call the Dark Forest home, each one handcrafted and drawn from the World of Trollheim. Some will wander over and join you by the campfire. Some will attack on sight. Calm their nerves or offer them something in return, and they might even come and live with you.
Make the Forest Your Home

Let creativity shape your dwelling, wherever feels like home. Build idyllic housing in the treetops, within hollowed logs, tucked into rock crevices or by the mist-filled forest lakes. Add bridges, clad your walls in moss and set some low lighting, whether you're blending into nature or standing out as uniquely yours.
Survive and Thrive
TROLLHEIM: GNOMES is a place to connect with yourself, nature, and each other. It is fully playable solo offline or in co-op with friends, supporting up to 8 players.
For more adventures in the Dark Forest visit our website
Enter the Dark Forest and the untold tales of Väsen through an interconnected narrative spanning books, collectibles, music, games, and more.

about.text: Take apart, clean and bring new life to long forgotten objects in Reshine - a cozy restoration game that will take you on a journey through history, all within the safe space of your own attic.
Reshine is a chill, relaxing experience. Simple and intuitive controls, minimalistic UI, straightforward gameplay. There are no complicated systems, no management, no stress.

Listen to the rainfall, as you slowly work in a quiet attic, where the time seems to have stopped. Surrounded by relics of the past, take apart each object piece by piece. There’s no rush, you can follow your own rhythm, discovering how everything fits together as you go. With nothing to get wrong, you’re free to simply unwind and enjoy the process.

The parts need to be restored to their former glory. Clean away the dust, sand down rough edges, and gently remove the rust using a variety of tools. Pick colors that feel right for you and repaint the surface until it looks good as new. Go in any order you want and just sit back, relax and watch the object come back to life.

When every part looks like new, you can slowly bring everything back together. Piece by piece, watch the object take shape again. Before you know it, it’s looking like its old self again, or maybe even better.

And that's it! Compare your final result with the object before restoration to see how much it has changed. You can repeat the restoration as many times as you want, to try different colors or just relive the experience. But, most importantly, more old treasures await you!

about.text: Build the Legendary Ski Resort you've always dreamed of.
You start with just a ticket office and a bit of cash. Transform an empty mountain into a Legendary Resort in this management tycoon game from an industry veteran and passionate skier.
No rigid grid system. Paint trails directly onto terrain built from real LiDAR data from around the world.
You need a variety of trails for all types of skiers: green circles for beginners, black diamonds for the brave.
Build cozy ski villages with lodges, restaurants, après bars, shopping, and more!

Drought means running snowblowers around the clock just to stay open.
A big dump buries your buildings before the lifts even spin.
A cool summer keeps your peaks soft and fluffy for the next season.

Play across every major ski region on Earth - from the five US regions to Japan, the Alps, the Andes, Canada, Australia and New Zealand, and China.

about.text: Welcome to Farm & Feast! 🌿

Farm & Feast is a relaxing simulation game where a warm little farm meets an adorable cozy restaurant. Everything moves at your own pace. Your fields are waiting, your restaurant is open, and so are your customers. Every day something new grows, and every service turns into a little moment of happiness.
The more care you show your customers, the warmer your restaurant becomes. Every smile, every order made with love, builds a bond that reaches far beyond the tables.
Take a little break by the shore and cast your line into the gentle waves. Wait for that tiny tug, reel in your catch, and bring it fresh to your kitchen.

Harvest your golden wheat row by row and watch your little machines turn every grain into warm loaves of bread. From a single seed to your customers' tables, every step carries a little piece of your love.

Sometimes the loveliest moments are the quietest ones. A gentle breeze, a path winding between the fields, and a world that feels made just for you. As you gently tend the soil, time slows down; only you and the greenery growing day by day remain. Caring for your field isn't a chore, it's a quiet peace where you get to be alone with yourself.
Greet every guest with a warm smile and welcome them to a comfortable table. Even a small "Welcome" can set the tone for an entire day.

Every service has a rhythm of its own. Fill your tray with drinks, move from table to table, and leave each glass with just the right owner. As you carry the drinks, gather up the smiles along the way and savor that delightful flow that keeps your restaurant cozy and warm.

Bring the orders to your chefs, and they'll handle the rest. While the pans sizzle, sweep the floors and clear the tables at your own rhythm. A cozy restaurant is built with patience and care for the little details.

Taking the bill is the finale of every lovely moment you share with a customer. The warm bond you've built throughout the day, the care you've shown, and every little smile all pay off in this final moment. When your guests leave the table happy, those little tips they leave alongside the bill become the sweetest thank-you for your hard work.
Take every order with care and listen closely to your customers. A wrong dish or a forgotten request upsets your guest and casts a shadow over your restaurant's warm reputation.
Your day begins in the morning on your farm and ends in the evening with happy customers at your restaurant. No rush, no pressure, just your day.
FEATURES
🌾 Farming and Harvest - Plant your seeds, water your crops with love, and watch them grow. When harvest time comes, gather your fresh produce and send it off to your restaurant.
🎣 Fishing - Head down to the shore, cast your line into the gentle waves, and reel in fresh fish for your restaurant's kitchen.
🍽️ Restaurant Management - Greet your customers with a warm smile, seat them at their tables, and take their orders with care. Let every service turn into a little moment of happiness.
🎮 Mini Games - Add a little fun to your day with the charming mini games waiting for you at your restaurant.
🛒 Market - Pick up the seeds and supplies you need at the market and stock up on what's missing. Grow your little business step by step.
🌍 Your Little World - Find your own rhythm between the farm and the restaurant. Plan your day at a calm pace and savor every moment of it.
A warm little farm, an adorable restaurant, and a little world that belongs to you alone. Farm & Feast is waiting for you.

about.text: There is one rule of brick sorting. Everyone learns it the hard way.

You've inherited a workshop and a Pile that swallowed it whole. Never Sort By Color is a zen organization sim about setting it right - sorting an impossibly huge mountain of plastic bricks into a perfectly labeled workshop, one satisfying handful at a time.
Tame the Pile
The Pile doesn't look conquerable. That's the point. Start by picking out bricks one at a time, and grow into an unstoppable sorting machine:
Magnet Glove - aim at a part and every loose copy rips out of the Pile and streams into your hand.
Sorter's Eye - mark a part type and watch every instance glow through the chaos.
Sieve Tray - scoop, shake, and let gravity sort a whole load by size in one motion.
Bucket Sort - bind bins to hotkeys and fling bricks blind over your shoulder, pure muscle memory.
Locators - hold up any brick and its home drawer lights up across the room.
Buy bins, trays, and cabinet walls. Stack them into towers. Label everything. Watch the floor appear.
Pull the parts. Watch it build.

Instruction books lie scattered around the workshop, each one a MOC waiting for parts. Crack one open, pull its bill of materials from your perfect drawers, and watch the model build itself, brick by brick - a time-lapse of parts flying up and clicking into place, stud by stud.
This is where your sorting pays off or bites. Honest drawers mean a full kit pulls in seconds. A contaminated drawer means the tray rejects your wrong part right in front of you.
Finished models don't ship away - they fill your workshop. A fire truck on the windowsill. A spaceship hung from the ceiling. Pick one up and swoosh it around the room. I won't tell.
Chaos in. Order out.
One workshop, one enormous Pile, one deeply satisfying loop.
No timers, no fail states - just you, the bricks, and the quiet click of things going where they belong.
Every brick you sort visibly shrinks the mountain. The before/after is the game.
The Rule
Sorting by color feels right. It looks beautiful. And every brick collector on earth will tell you the same thing: you will never find anything again.
Sort by part. Always by part.
Never. Sort. By. Color.

about.text: No Body, No Problem is an asymmetrical, physics-based social stealth game for 4 players, packed with laughter as you and your friends attempt to pull off the perfect crime.
A murder has taken place. There is a body that needs to be hidden. The call has been made, and the police are on the way.

Three players control the suspects, while one player takes the role of the police officer responding to the report. The suspects must hide the body, remove the evidence, and leave the scene without raising suspicion. The officer must search every corner, track suspicious behaviour, and find the body that proves the murder.
Time is your greatest enemy. The police could knock on the door at any moment, and one small mistake can bring the entire plan crashing down in seconds.
There Is No Such Thing as a Perfect Crime
Every match unfolds through complete improvisation.

A friend may panic while carrying the body, the wardrobe you chose may not be as safe as you expected, or the tiniest clue left behind may catch the officer’s attention. Plans often fall apart within the first few minutes, forcing you to act entirely under pressure.
That is exactly where the fun begins.
The Cop Is Trying to See Everything
The cop is not only looking for the body.

An open door, a broken object, a freshly cleaned floor, or even strange behaviour from the players can create suspicion. Examine the crime scene carefully, search every room, and turn the suspects’ smallest mistake into an advantage.
A new clue could appear at any second.
Every Location Is a Different Puzzle
No two matches play out the same way.

The crime scene may be a small apartment, a crowded shop, a multi-storey car park, or somewhere completely different. Every map offers its own hiding places, interactive objects, and unexpected opportunities.
A method that works on one map may expose you on another.
Physics-Based Chaos
Almost every object in the game interacts through physics.
While carrying the body, you may knock over furniture, get stuck in narrow corridors, accidentally attract attention, or turn the entire place upside down without meaning to.
Even the best plan can become a hilarious disaster because of a single mistake.
How Much Do You Trust Your Friends?
The suspects must work together.

Good coordination can remove every piece of evidence before the police arrive. But as the pressure rises, panic begins. A friend may make the wrong decision, expose you, or blame everything on you to save themselves.
Every Match Tells a New Story
No two games are ever the same.
Different maps, hiding methods, physics-based interactions, and player decisions ensure that every match creates its own funny, chaotic, and unforgettable story.
One match may end with the perfect crime, while another may fall apart seconds after the police open the door.
Because sometimes it is not the police who ruin the perfect plan...
It is your friends.
No body, no problem.

You and your friends operate the feared German 88 mm anti-aircraft gun of the Second World War. Up to five players share one gun: someone watches the bombers and calls out the range, while the others aim, set fuzes or load the next round.

Then comes the first shot. You watch where the shell bursts and adjust. Too short? Too late? With every shot, you get to know the gun a little better. With practice, the next job gets done before anyone has to ask.
Find your place in the crew

Divide the jobs or move between stations when someone needs a hand. At the rangefinder, you track the incoming aircraft. At the aiming wheels, you keep the gun moving with them. Bringing up ammunition means your friends won't be left waiting at an empty breech.
Let one player handle both aiming axes or split elevation and traverse between two people. Keep talking to each other. A range called out in time matters just as much as the next shell being ready.
Get to know the 88
Work the handwheels and breech, carry ammunition from the supply point and prepare each round. Set the fuze so the shell bursts as close to the target as possible.

A burst behind the bomber formation tells you something. So does one that goes off too soon. Watch the result, adjust your fuze setting and lead, then try again. Over time, you'll get a feel for the gun and learn how to put shots on target together.
Keep an eye on the sky
By day, bomber formations cross your field of fire. At night, searchlight beams help you follow the aircraft. Hits can damage engines, tear away parts and bring bombers down.
Between waves, there's time to bring up more ammunition and get ready for the next approach.
Want a gun of your own?

In Arcade mode, each player gets a separate gun. An automatic crew handles range measurements, fuze settings and loading. You choose your targets and aim the gun yourself, playing alone or with up to four other players.
After each round, compare scores and use the experience you've earned to train your crew.
What to expect
First-person operation of the German 88 mm anti-aircraft gun.
Cooperative play for up to five players on one gun.
Manual aiming, rangefinding, fuze setting and loading.
Flexible crew roles, with separate or combined aiming controls.
Day and night missions against bomber formations.
Timed shell bursts and aircraft that show damage and break apart.
Solo and multiplayer Arcade mode with automatic crews, individual scores and crew training.
In Dirt Town you drive heavy machinery and move dirt. Create roads by felling trees, moving rocks, hauling gravel, digging ditches. Dig for resources and build a race track for the dirt bike!
Its a sandbox with multiplayer -- earn money by completing missions and harvesting resources, buy better machines -- and reach even further into the territory.
Revolutionary simulation
The whole site is one simulation. Everything you do, stays forever (in your save). You have not felt dirt like this in a game before. The simulation includes:
Being able to plow, dig and stack material anywhere on the map, always
Different materials, layered on each other. Sand is very different from clay in every way
Everything is destructible, some are just very hard
Moisture that affects grip and dirt movement
Water that flows and rain creating creeks and puddles
Rocks and trees interacting with the dirt and vehicles in realistic ways
Gameplay

We launch with a first map focused on mining and extracting resources, with lots of cool side missions. Find your way through the wilderness, break a road for the hauler, find the sources, and start shipping it out. Buy new vehicles and conveyors to make it easier.
Do side missions to spice things up:
Build a dirt bike track and race it with your friends
Jump the truck down a huge cliff
Crush gravel to improve your roads
Buy a compactor for even easier transport
Drain a swamp to find even more resources
Selection of cool features
Auto leveling system with slopes and curves. Set sticks, auto level with the dozer
Chains for towing -- multiplayer awesomeness
Get out on foot and climb -- both terrain and machines
Drill into rocks to hook them
Crush trees and brush
Attachments with real hooking system
System support
You need a decent computer to always have 60+ fps -- see the system requirements
We support most peripherals from gamepads to joysticks and wheels
Where we are going
We launch with a mining focused map, and are aiming to do a major update for snow shortly after.

about.text: The Moon is covered in dust. The Lunar Surface Department (LSD) has sent you and your crew to clean it up. Unfortunately, the budget only covered a toothbrush.
Collect lunar dust, sell and use the earnings to buy better tools and upgrade your equipment. Turn an underfunded cleanup mission into a growing operation, one painfully small brushstroke at a time.

Team up in online co-op lobbies of up to 16 players. Spread out to cover more ground or tackle the same area together. There’s enough dust to keep everyone busy. Whether everyone actually works is another matter.

Fill your storage with lunar dust, deliver it to a depot and launch shipments to get paid. Spend your earnings on new cleaning tools and increased carrying capacity so you can take on bigger jobs between deliveries.
Watch dusty terrain turn clean with every pass. Track your progress across the lunar surface, place depots near your work and put cleaning vehicles to use as your operation grows.
Stop being lazy, you’ve got whole Moon to clean. Better get started.

It's Saturday, 5:42 PM. The mower won't start, the beer is warm, and nobody has cut this grass in weeks.
An old man, an old mower

You're not here to relax. You're here to get it done, your way. Hold the key until the engine finally coughs to life, light a cigarette, crack a can and reach over to switch on the radio strapped to the hood. One hand on the wheel, the other one busy.
The most satisfying cut

Tall, thick, wind-blown grass that falls blade by blade under the deck. A sharp edge on every pass, clippings flying out of the chute, and stripes that follow the way you drive. When you're done, watch the whole job again as a timelapse.
Get off and finish the job
The mower can't reach everything. Climb down, grab the string trimmer and clean up along the fence, and around that one garden gnome. Out of gas? Walk to the gas can. Nobody's bringing it to you.
One more lawn

Start with your own front yard. Then the neighbors start calling. Elvira pays well, and she's picky: every blade cut, five centimeters, not one more, and nothing broken. Especially not her gnome. When you're done, she writes you a receipt. With comments.
Then, the golf course

Rubén wants the old Los Teros club back in shape: greens, fairways and tees, each at its own height. Between passes, play a couple of holes, fish the lost balls out of the pond, rake the bunkers, and pull the handbrake on the wet parking lot to see if a riding mower can drift. It can.
And then, an island

Marcela's niece is getting married on Saturday. 120 barefoot guests, no second takes. Load the mower onto an old ferry, cross the lake and mow the whole island. Drive into the water and the engine drowns (you can push it out). Also: a boat, a fishing rod, a hammock, coconuts and a beach bar.
Bring friends. Or don't.

Online co-op for up to 6 players, each on their own mower, all on the same lawn. Join with a Steam invite or a 6-digit code. Proximity voice chat, everyone's radio playing from their own hood, and plenty of ways to get nothing done: wave, point, dance, throw fruit at each other's heads, or punch a friend in the face. No damage. Just dizziness.
Take a break. Or don't.

Fire up the barbecue in Elvira's yard and keep an eye on the smoke while you mow. Toss your empties into the bin from the mower seat. Juggle the fruit from the table. Have a few too many and watch the stripes get creative.
Make your own lawns

A built-in map editor: paint grass, sand, dirt and paths, dig ponds, raise hills, plant trees, put up fences and place as many gnomes as you dare. Hit Test Drive and mow it. Share your maps on the Steam Workshop and play the ones other people make.
Features
A first-person riding mower with a steering wheel you can see turn and a mechanical dashboard: hold-to-start key, blade switch, deck-height lever, lights, fuel gauge and a radio.
Dense, living grass that reacts to the wind, the wheels and the blades. Real stripes, clean edges, flying clippings.
Four jobs: your front yard, Elvira's backyard, Rubén's golf course and Marcela's island. Each client judges your work, and each one has opinions.

about.text: Somewhere beneath this gigantic junkyard lies your Bitcoin USB stick. Find the right one among many.
1. Collect and Burn
Pull scrap out, carry it to the furnace and throw it in. Every piece pays coins. The deeper you dig, the more it pays.
2. Buy Upgrades
More than 60 upgrades in a skill tree, and more are planned.
3. Collect More and Burn More
Suck up a whole tank of scrap and shoot it into the furnace. And there are many more ways to farm more efficiently and progress faster.
4. Build a Factory

Up on the deck you build a factory of your own. Cranes lift scrap out, belts and sorting gates send it on, and machines turn it into rubber ducks, piggy banks, arcade machines and little robots. It earns money while you dig.
5. Check USB Sticks and Find Treasures

USB sticks are everywhere, and they all look the same. Only the computer on the platform tells you what is on one. Along the way you find crates, safes, golden pieces and an entire sailing ship buried under the scrap. Cut your way in. Maybe you'll find your Bitcoins and get rich.

about.text: There are plenty of theories about how the pyramids were built.
You and your friends have one too. It involves 23,426 bricks, a lot of hard work and probably a few questionable decisions.
How They Built the Pyramids is an online co-op building game for 1–8 players. Start by making bricks from Nile clay, then work together to build a 65-metre pyramid, one block at a time.
It's a lot of work. Luckily, you don't have to do it all by hand.
MAKE BRICKS. LOTS OF THEM.
It all starts with a bit of mud. Turn raw clay into bricks, improve their quality and find ways to make the whole process faster. You'll be making a lot of them.
GET THEM UP THERE
Carry bricks, toss them to your friends or find your own way of getting them to the top. Just make sure you're not standing underneath when something comes crashing down.
MANY HANDS MAKE LIGHT WORK
Bring your friends along, split up the work and get a proper operation going. Still need more hands? Hire some Shabti to help out. Just remember to keep them happy.
BUILD YOUR EMPIRE

What starts as a few people carrying bricks eventually becomes something much bigger. Build, connect and automate your production. Let the machines do the heavy lifting while you focus on getting that pyramid finished.
THERE ARE EASIER WAYS. BUT WHERE'S THE FUN?

Launch your friends across the pyramid. Send bricks flying through the air. Experiment with some rather unconventional construction methods. There is more than one way to get a brick where it needs to go.
ONE VERY BIG PYRAMID
26 layers. 65 metres tall. 23,426 blocks.
Finish the pyramid together, then keep building. Raise monuments, earn blessings and see just how far your little operation can go.
FEATURES
1–8 player online co-op. Build together, divide the work or get in each other's way.
23,426 blocks to place. One giant pyramid, built by your crew.
Build and automate. Turn a small brick-making operation into a fully running production line.
Get some help. Recruit little workers to take care of the less exciting jobs.
Find creative solutions. Carry, toss, launch and transport bricks in all sorts of ways.
Grow stronger. Improve your abilities and carry more as your operation grows.

about.text: One billion dollars. One shredder. You.

A gigantic bank vault is buried under money up to the ceiling — mountains of bills and bundles. Your job is simple and glorious: dig through all that wealth and feed it to the shredder. Every bill pays out, every upgrade makes you faster, and the mountain keeps shrinking.
Grab, scoop, suck it up

Start with your bare hands: grab bills one by one and carry them to the shredder. Then go bigger: a bucket, a shovel and a powerful vacuum that pulls money in a swirling vortex. When your hands get tired, launch drones — they mine and haul the cash without you.
Upgrades you can't put down
Over 100 upgrades for your tools, the shredder and your drones
A skill tree with branches for your play style
Boosts, relics and golden banknotes for the long run
Numbers climb from your first dollars to trillions — and beyond
A secret at the bottom of the vault

The vault goes five levels deep. The deeper you dig, the bigger the bills. Shred every last bill, pick up the golden key and open the massive door at the bottom. What's behind it? Find out for yourself.
Better together

Play solo or invite up to three friends to online co-op. Shared progress, one shared mountain of money, voice and text chat — dig together, argue about who buys the next upgrade, and shred a billion as a team.
Features
A cozy first-person incremental game
Exactly one billion banknotes in the vault, counted down to the very last one
Online co-op for up to 4 players with voice chat
Drone automation — up to 16 drones dig and haul the cash on their own
Five signature moves: ARMFUL, HEAVE, GROUND POUND, OVERLOAD and RALLY
The jetpack lifts you out of any pit
Customize your thief and find hats in buried chests
A Steam leaderboard for the fastest vault clear, solo and in co-op
100 Steam achievements
Fully localized into 30 languages

about.text: An asteroid of 5,000,000 m³ will hit Earth in 90 days. The government already spent 90 days arguing about who pays. Then one miner came to the tender with his own pickaxe. He asked for no money and said the asteroid would pay for itself. The vote was unanimous, for the first time in history.

You are that miner. Every day you fly down and dig while your air lasts. Back on the ship you sell the ore and buy bigger tools and guns. A big counter shows how many m³ are left. On the first day it hardly moves. Later your ship fires at the rock while you dig, and the number goes down much faster.
From a pickaxe to a missile swarm
You start with the pickaxe you brought. The last tool is a swarm of small homing missiles. Big pieces break off and float away, and you can ride them.
The ship shoots too

Earth has rockets that are already paid for, but they are aimed at the neighbors. So your ship starts with no guns, and you buy them with the ore money. They fire at the asteroid on their own. The most expensive one shoots a black hole into the rock.
Bring a crew

The contract is for one miner, but the government does not check how many came. Up to 8 players can dig the same asteroid in online co-op. The pay is still zero. The ore money goes into one wallet, and the host decides who can spend it. Anyone who sits in the lander can start a 10-second count, or kick a friend out of the hatch. If you are not in the lander when it leaves the asteroid, you black out and lose your cargo. The campaign is the host's save, and guests keep their own game.
Earth is watching

What you find in the rock goes to the ship's museum, like an empty safe labeled "Asteroid defense budget". From the observation dome you can see Earth through a telescope. A crowd holds KEEP WORKING signs. Bookmakers take bets on you. The government meets on a beach. The plot at the impact point is already sold, and the owners rave about the sky view.
Other clients
After the main contract, other clients send offers. A space hotel wants a duck-shaped asteroid gone, because guests say it keeps staring at them.
Singleplayer, or online co-op for up to 8 players. Alone, the main contract takes about 6 to 9 hours.
